hero.title: Why Study Public Health in Ireland?
hero.subtitle: Ireland offers world-class Master of Public Health (MPH) and Population Health degrees at UCC, University of Galway, and RCSI, combining epidemiology, biostatistics, and global health policy with a 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa.

overview: Students interested in Public Health in Ireland benefit from internationally recognized 1-year full-time MPH programmes, strong HSE and European health-agency research links, and English-taught curricula.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps Indian students shortlist top Irish public health schools, verify academic and IELTS requirements, prepare applications, and manage student visa documentation.
